purpose: Release performance budgets for the native full-chain validation gate.

runtime_profile.stage2_native_threads: THREADS make variable; default 0 lets the native runner use all available processing threads

stages.algorithmic_guard: Raw candidate loading must remain linear in candidate rows and interferogram columns.
CLAP filtering and topofit iteration must avoid dense all-pairs candidate work.
Selection must stream over candidate rows without materializing unnecessary dense history.
Weeding graph construction must stay sparse and avoid complete PS edge lists.

temporary_waiver.reason: US-007 restores exact Stage 4 weed parity and reduces validation runtime, but large validation patches still exceed the original 10s patch budget on this runner.

stages.algorithmic_guard: Patch promotion must copy selected rows directly without reorder-expanding full patch history.
Merged aggregation must preserve patch order and avoid quadratic overlap scans.

temporary_waiver.reason: US-015 removed redundant merged Stage 5 selector copies and unused ph_reref parsing, but merged MAT v5 serialization remains IO-bound slightly above the original 30s stage-local budget on this runner while total native stage runtime stays under the 600s release budget.

stages.algorithmic_guard: Interpolation must use grid labels or sparse graph neighborhoods, not grid-by-PS brute force.
SCLA smoothing must keep arc neighborhoods sparse and avoid complete PS edge materialization.
Space-time filtering must operate on existing edge tables without dense all-pairs expansion.
